description: Full-length upright young adult woman in opaque russet-red fitted wool overdress/gown with low square neckline, elbow-length outer sleeves over cream linen fitted sleeves/underdress, narrow woven borders, practical brown belt/round buckle and red wrap resting along forearms. Floor-length skirt has lower front opening showing cream underlayer and one brown shoe; other foot concealed by hem. Plain stone doorway, no headgear/armor/weapons. Dark loose asymmetric waves fall over viewer-right shoulder; some top sections gathered back.
